It repeats that page's visible text and adds nothing to it: Southern Tier Startup Alliance – We support people starting and growing companies in the region. Contact Home Find an Incubator About Benefits Entrepreneurs-in-Residence Operational Team News Investment Reports Home Find an Incubator About Benefits Entrepreneurs-in-Residence Operational Team News Investment Reports Home Find an Incubator About Benefits Entrepreneurs-in-Residence Operational Team News Investment Reports Southern Tier Startup Alliance (STSA) The Southern Tier Startup Alliance (STSA) is a member organization of business incubators in the Southern Tier region of New York, promoting business development resources for entrepreneurs and startups in the region. STSA also serves as Launch New York’s representative in the Southern Tier, helping connect startups with funding and mentorship. Our objective is to help increase the number of jobs in the region by supporting new, scalable businesses, thus diversifying the employment base and strengthening the economy.
